text: 35 yr old male teacher with cough for 10 days, initially dry, now with some whitish sputum. It started after a runny nose and sore throat. No breathlessness, no chest pain, no haemoptysis. Non-smoker, no asthma. T 37.6 C, HR 88, RR 16, SpO2 98% on room air. Chest: few scattered rhonchi, no crepitations, no bronchial breathing. CXR clear.

28F c/o cough x 1 wk, low grade fever first 2 days, now afebrile. Chest tightness while coughing. No SOB, no h/o asthma or allergy. T 37.2, PR 84, RR 18, SpO2 99%. Throat mildly congested. Chest: B/L occasional wheeze, no crepts. TLC 7,800.

62 yr male, k/c/o DM on metformin (HbA1c 7.2). Cough x 2 wks with whitish sputum, began after a cold, mild fever only for the first 2 days. No weight loss, no night sweats, no haemoptysis, no TB contact, non-smoker. T 37.4, HR 90, RR 18, SpO2 97% RA. Chest: scattered rhonchi, no crepts, no dullness. CXR: no infiltrate. TLC 8,200, CRP 12.

45M c/o fever with chills x 3 days, cough with rusty sputum, right sided chest pain on deep breathing. T 38.9 C, HR 104, RR 22, BP 124/80, SpO2 95% RA. Alert and oriented. Chest: bronchial breath sounds and crepts R infrascapular area. CXR: R lower lobe consolidation. TLC 15,600, urea 32 mg/dL.

32F, c/o fever x 4d, productive cough yellow sputum x 3d, mild SOB. No h/o TB, no TB contact. T 38.4 C, PR 98, BP 110/70, RR 20, SpO2 96%. Chest - L basal crepts, decreased air entry L base. CXR - L lower zone patchy opacity. TLC 13,200 N 84%. Urea 24.

55 yr male, smoker
Fever 5 days
Cough with greenish sputum
Breathless on walking
T 38.6 C, HR 102, RR 24, BP 130/84, SpO2 94% RA
Conscious, oriented
R mid zone crepts + bronchial breathing
CXR: R middle lobe consolidation
Urea 30 mg/dL, TLC 16,000

68 yr old lady, k/c/o DM x 15 yrs and HTN, brought by son for generalised weakness and poor appetite x 3 days with mild cough. No documented fever, felt warm at night. No chest pain, no vomiting, no urinary complaints. Alert, oriented. T 37.9 C, HR 96, RR 22, BP 136/80, SpO2 95% RA. R basal crepts. CXR: R lower zone patchy consolidation. TLC 12,400, urea 38 mg/dL, RBS 262.

22M college student, dry cough x 7 days with low grade fever, headache and body ache. Two hostel room-mates had a similar illness. No breathlessness. T 38.1, HR 92, RR 20, SpO2 96%. Throat mildly congested. Chest: few fine crepts L base. CXR: L lower zone patchy infiltrate, more extensive than the exam suggests. TLC 9,800, platelets normal.

58M, drinks daily (180 ml), c/o fever with cough x 4 days, sputum yellow, R side chest pain on breathing. No hemoptysis, no weight loss, no night sweats. T 38.3, HR 106, RR 22, BP 118/76, SpO2 95%, oriented. R lower zone crepts. CXR: RLL consolidation, no cavity, no effusion. Urea 28, TLC 14,200.

42F, obese, presents with right upper abdominal pain for 2 days, constant, radiating to the right shoulder, which began after a fatty meal, with nausea and 2 episodes of vomiting. Fever since last night. Gallstones were seen on an ultrasound a year ago, not operated. T 38.3 C, HR 102, BP 128/80. Tender right hypochondrium with inspiratory arrest on deep palpation. No jaundice. TLC 14,800, bilirubin 1.1, ALP normal. USG: distended GB, thick wall, pericholecystic fluid.

38F c/o pain upper abdomen R side x 1 day, vomiting ++, fever with chills. P/A: tenderness R hypochondrium, Murphy's +, no guarding elsewhere. Icterus nil. T 38.6, PR 108, BP 116/76. TLC 16,200. LFT: bili 1.4, ALP 130, ALT 58. Lipase normal. USG: GB calculi, wall 5 mm, sonographic Murphy +, CBD normal.

72 yr old male, DM on insulin, c/o vague upper abdominal discomfort and poor intake x 3 days, feels feverish. No clear pain history, no haematemesis, no black stools. T 37.9, HR 104, BP 108/70, RR 20. Mild tenderness R hypochondrium, Murphy equivocal. No jaundice. TLC 17,400, RBS 310, ALP normal, lipase normal, ECG no acute changes. USG: GB calculi with wall thickening and pericholecystic fluid.

66F admitted 8 days ago for pyelonephritis, on IV ceftriaxone. Since 2 days has watery diarrhoea 8 to 10 times a day with lower abdominal cramps. No blood in stool. T 38.2, HR 104, BP 112/70. Abdomen mildly distended, diffusely tender, no guarding. TLC 22,000, creatinine 1.6 (0.9 at admission).

34M, took cefixime + ofloxacin x 7 days for UTI 3 wks back. Now c/o loose stools x 5 days, 6-7/day, foul smelling, crampy lower abdominal pain. Low grade fever. No travel, no outside food, no blood in stool, others at home well. T 37.8, HR 92. P/A soft, mild lower abd tenderness. TLC 13,500.

78M, k/c/o CKD, on pantoprazole long term, took clindamycin for a dental abscess 2 wks ago. Now 3 days of watery diarrhoea, reduced intake, very weak. Afebrile. HR 108, BP 96/60, tongue dry. Abdomen distended, mildly tender, bowel sounds present. TLC 28,000, creatinine 2.4 (baseline 1.5), albumin 2.6.

26M with frequent small-volume stools containing blood and mucus for 2 days, more than 10 times a day, cramping lower abdominal pain and a constant urge to pass stool. High fever. Ate at a roadside stall 3 days ago. T 39.0 C, HR 110, BP 110/70. Mildly dehydrated. Lower abdominal tenderness, no guarding. Stool: many pus cells and RBCs.

45F c/o loose motions with blood x 1 day, 12-15 episodes, tenesmus +, fever with chills. Family member with similar complaints. No recent antibiotics. T 38.7, PR 104, BP 104/70. Tongue dry. P/A: LIF tenderness. Stool R/E: pus cells plenty, RBC ++.

70 yr diabetic male
Loose stools x 3 days, blood streaked with mucus, 8/day
Lower abdominal cramps
Feels feverish and very weak
No h/o IBD, no recent antibiotics
Drinks untreated well water
T 38.4, HR 112, BP 92/60, dry mucosa
P/A diffuse tenderness, no rigidity

30M with vomiting and watery loose stools for 1 day after a wedding feast; 6 stools and 4 vomits so far. Crampy periumbilical pain. No blood in stool. T 37.6, HR 96, BP 118/76. Mild dehydration. Abdomen soft, mildly tender, bowel sounds increased.

24F c/o loose stools x 2 days, watery, 5-6/day, nausea +, mild fever. Room-mate has similar sx. No blood/mucus, no urinary sx, no recent antibiotics. T 37.9, PR 92, BP 110/70. Tongue moist. P/A soft, NT.

Vomiting x 12 h, 8 episodes
Watery diarrhoea, 8 episodes
Ate leftover rice last night
No fever, no blood in stool
HR 112, BP 94/62
Dry tongue, sunken eyes, reduced skin turgor
P/A soft, mild diffuse tenderness
Urea 48, creat 1.2

74F, k/c/o HTN on amlodipine, losartan and hydrochlorothiazide, c/o loose stools and vomiting x 2 days, not eating. Giddy on standing. Afebrile. HR 106, BP 98/60 lying, 92/56 standing. Dry mucosa. P/A soft, non-tender. No blood in stool. Creat 1.6 (baseline 0.9), Na 131, K 3.2.

19M hostel student c/o vomiting, loose stools, low grade fever and body ache x 1 day. Many students in the hostel mess are affected. Stools watery, no blood. T 38.1, HR 98. Mild dehydration. P/A soft, no guarding.

56M, T2DM on metformin, c/o watery loose stools x 3 days, 5-6/day, with nausea and periumbilical cramps. No blood, no fever, no recent antibiotics or hospital stay. HR 94, BP 124/80. Mild dehydration. P/A soft. RBS 210, urine ketones negative.

48M, chronic alcoholic, had a binge with an episode of unconsciousness 3 wks ago. Now fever x 2 wks, cough with large amounts of foul smelling sputum, occasionally blood-streaked. Poor dentition. T 38.5, HR 104, RR 22, SpO2 95%. R posterior crepts. CXR: thick-walled cavity with air-fluid level in R lower lobe superior segment.

65M, old CVA with swallowing difficulty, chokes on liquids. c/o fever x 10 days, cough with foul expectoration, wt loss. T 38.2, PR 100, RR 24, SpO2 94%. R lower zone crepts. CXR: cavity with air-fluid level RLL. TLC 18,000.

55M, uncontrolled DM, fever and cough x 3 wks, sputum copious and putrid, mild night sweats, weight loss 3 kg. Dental extraction 5 wks back. No TB contact. T 38.4, HR 102, RR 20, SpO2 96%. L lower zone dull with crepts. CXR: 5 cm cavity with air-fluid level L lower lobe, upper lobes clear. Sputum AFB x2 negative. RBS 320.

19F with sore throat for 2 days, painful swallowing and fever. No cough, no cold. T 38.6 C, HR 98. Tonsils enlarged with white exudates bilaterally, tender anterior cervical nodes. No rash, no hepatosplenomegaly, uvula central.
28M c/o sore throat, runny nose, sneezing and mild dry cough x 2 days. Low grade fever. T 37.7. Throat congested, no exudate, no cervical nodes. Chest clear.

23M c/o throat pain x 3d, fever with chills, pain on swallowing. No cough/coryza. O/E: T 38.9, PR 104, tonsils grade 3 with exudate, tender jugulodigastric LN B/L. Uvula central, no trismus. TLC 14,000 N 86%.

35F
Sore throat x 3 days
Runny nose, red watery eyes, hoarse voice
Dry cough
Low grade fever
T 37.9, HR 90
Pharynx congested, no exudate
Few small non-tender nodes
Chest clear

58M, diabetic on gliclazide, c/o severe sore throat x 3 days with fever. Able to swallow saliva, no trismus, no drooling, voice normal. No cough. T 38.4, HR 100. B/L tonsils congested with patchy exudate, tender cervical nodes. Neck swelling nil. RBS 240.
42F teacher, sore throat and hoarseness x 2 days following a cold, nasal blockage and sneezing. Afebrile. Throat mildly congested, no exudate, no nodes. Ears and chest normal.

30M, works with stray dogs at a shelter, has removed ticks from them. Fever x 6 days, severe headache, myalgia. Rash from day 3, started on wrists and ankles, spread to trunk, involving palms and soles, maculopapular becoming petechial on legs. T 39.0, HR 108, BP 110/70. No eschar found on careful search. Mild hepatomegaly. Platelets 90,000, AST 120, ALT 90, Na 131. Dengue NS1 and IgM negative, malaria RDT negative.

26F c/o fever x 5d, h/o tick bite while trekking in forest 1 wk back. Rash x 2d incl palms/soles. Headache ++, body pains. O/E: T 38.8, PR 102. Small black crusted lesion R ankle at bite site. Maculopapular rash all over. No jaundice. Plt 1.1 lakh, ALT 85.

60F, diabetic, from a village, fever x 8 days not responding to cefixime given by a local doctor. Headache and vomiting. Family keeps goats, ticks seen on the animals. Faint maculopapular rash on forearms and soles, noted only on careful exam. Pedal edema. T 38.6, HR 106, BP 100/64. Plt 60,000, TLC 11,000, AST 180, creat 1.5, Na 128. Widal 1:80, malaria smear negative.

70M, smoker, fever and productive cough x 4 days, breathless since yesterday, confused this morning. T 38.8, HR 122, RR 34, BP 84/50, SpO2 86% RA. Disoriented to time. B/L crepts, bronchial breathing R base. CXR: R lower and middle lobe consolidation with L lower zone patch. Urea 78 mg/dL, creat 2.1, TLC 21,000, lactate 3.8.

55F, k/c/o DM, c/o fever x 5d, cough with rusty sputum, R chest pain on breathing, SOB ++ x 2d. O/E: drowsy but arousable, T 39.2, PR 118, BP 96/60, RR 32, SpO2 88% on RA, 94% on 6 L O2. R sided crepts throughout, bronchial breath sounds. CXR: R upper + lower lobe consolidation. Urea 64, TLC 19,800, RBS 340.

82 yr old lady, HTN, brought with reduced intake and increasing breathlessness x 2 days; family says she is confused. No fever recorded at home, mild cough. No orthopnea, no pedal edema. T 36.4, HR 112, RR 30, BP 88/56, SpO2 85% RA. JVP not raised. B/L basal crepts, R > L. CXR: bilateral lower lobe consolidation, heart size normal. Urea 92, creat 1.9, lactate 3.1, Na 128.

24M with severe headache for 2 days, fever, photophobia and 3 episodes of vomiting. Fully conscious, GCS 15. T 38.4, HR 96, BP 120/78. Neck stiffness present, Kernig positive. No focal deficit, no rash, no papilloedema. CSF: clear, 180 cells (lymphocytes 85%), protein 70, glucose 62 (blood 104), Gram stain no organisms.

19F, c/o fever x 3d, headache ++, neck pain. Preceded by sore throat and loose stools last week. Sensorium normal. T 38.2, PR 100. Neck rigidity +, no FND, fundus normal. CSF: cells 90, L 90%, sugar 58 (RBS 100), protein 55, ADA 3.

34F
Headache x 4 days, fever, mild photophobia
Took amoxicillin for 2 days from local chemist
Oriented, GCS 15
T 38.0, HR 94, BP 118/74
Mild neck stiffness, no rash, no FND, no seizure
CSF: pressure normal, 60 cells (L 70%), glucose 60 (blood 96), protein 60, Gram stain and AFB negative

48M c/o reduced urine output x 2 days following 3 days of loose stools and vomiting. Taking diclofenac for body pain. HR 108, BP 96/60. Dry mucosa. Creat 3.2 (0.9 a year back), urea 110, K 5.4, Na 134. Urine: bland sediment.

62M, DM and HTN on telmisartan, had CT angiography 3 days ago. Now creatinine 2.6 from 1.2 and urine output reduced. No fever, no urinary symptoms. BP 150/90, HR 84. Mild pedal edema. K 5.8. Urine: trace protein, no RBCs. USG: normal-sized kidneys, no hydronephrosis.

26M labourer, worked long hours in the sun and collapsed; now cola-coloured urine and passing very little urine x 1 day, with generalised muscle pains. T 37.6, HR 104, BP 110/70. Muscles tender. Urine dipstick blood 3+ but microscopy 0-2 RBC. CPK 48,000, creat 3.8, K 6.2.

58F, k/c/o HTN, c/o decreased urine x 3d, swelling feet, breathless x 1 d. Taking nimesulide for knee OA x 2 wks. No fever. BP 170/100, PR 92, RR 24, SpO2 93%. B/L basal crepts, pedal edema +. Creat 4.6 (normal 6 months back), urea 160, K 6.1, HCO3 16. USG: normal sized kidneys, no hydronephrosis.

70M
Not passing urine properly x 2 days
Lower abdominal discomfort
Poor stream and nocturia x 1 yr
Afebrile, BP 146/88
Palpable tender bladder
Creat 3.4, urea 120 (creat 1.0 last year)
USG: bilateral hydroureteronephrosis, prostate 60 g

76F, HTN, heart failure on furosemide, ramipril and spironolactone, poor oral intake due to a febrile illness last week (now resolved). Brought for drowsiness and weakness x 2 days, urine output less. HR 56, BP 100/60. Dry. Creat 3.0 (baseline 1.1), K 7.0, Na 129. ECG: tall tented T waves.

72M fainted while climbing stairs today, brief loss of consciousness, recovered within a minute. Exertional chest tightness and breathlessness for 6 months. No tongue bite, no incontinence, no post-event confusion. BP 110/90, HR 72 regular, pulse slow rising and low volume. Harsh ejection systolic murmur at right 2nd ICS radiating to carotids, soft S2. ECG: LVH with strain.

68F, c/o giddiness and blackout on exertion x 2 episodes in 1 month, DOE grade II. No palpitations before the episodes. BP 104/80, PR 76 reg, low volume. CVS: ESM grade 4/6 aortic area radiating to carotids, S2 soft. ECG: LVH. RBS normal, Hb 12.6.

78M, DM, HTN, CAD s/p stent. Fell at home while walking to the toilet, brief LOC, small forehead abrasion. Says he is breathless on walking and tired for some months. BP 118/88, HR 64. Systolic murmur heard at apex and base, radiating to neck, single S2. ECG: LVH, ST depression lateral leads. RBS 180, troponin normal.

45F with headache for 2 months, worse in the mornings and on coughing, now with vomiting. Family notes she has become forgetful and apathetic. No fever, no weight loss. BP 130/80. Bilateral papilloedema, mild left pronator drift. No neck stiffness.

52M, c/o first episode GTCS 1 day back. H/o progressive weakness R hand x 3 wks, difficulty finding words. Mild headache x 1 month. No fever, no trauma. Now GCS 15, R UL power 4/5, mild expressive aphasia. Fundus: early disc swelling.

66M, smoker 40 pack-years, c/o unsteadiness while walking x 3 wks, headache, vomiting. Lost 6 kg in 3 months. Chronic cough. Afebrile, BP 138/84. Truncal ataxia, past pointing L side. Fundus normal. Na 133, RBS 104.

52M, HTN on hydrochlorothiazide, woke up with a severely painful, red, swollen right big toe after a party with heavy alcohol. Cannot bear the bedsheet touching it. T 37.8. R 1st MTP hot, swollen, erythematous, exquisitely tender. Other joints normal. Uric acid 8.9, TLC 11,000.

74F c/o acute pain and swelling L knee x 2 days, no trauma. Low grade fever. T 38.1, HR 92. L knee warm, effusion +, painful ROM. X-ray: linear calcification of menisci. Aspirate: turbid, WBC 18,000, Gram stain negative.

60M
DM, CKD 3, on low-dose aspirin
Pain and swelling R ankle x 1 day, felt feverish
Similar attack in big toe 2 yrs ago
T 37.9, HR 102
R ankle hot, red, swollen, skin shiny; no wound
TLC 13,800, CRP 90, uric acid 9.6, creat 1.8
Joint aspirate: WBC 30,000, Gram stain negative

38F, 10 days after LSCS, with left calf pain and swelling for 2 days. No chest pain or breathlessness. T 37.3, HR 90, SpO2 98%. Left calf circumference 4 cm more than right, pitting edema up to the knee, calf tender. No erythema or wound.

55M, k/c/o Ca stomach on chemo, c/o R leg swelling x 4 d, pain on walking. No SOB/chest pain. PR 88, SpO2 97%. R thigh + calf swollen, pitting, tender along femoral vein, dilated superficial veins. Wt loss 8 kg in 3 months.

64F, DM, obese, TKR L knee 2 wks ago. Now L leg swelling x 3 days, calf pain, mild warmth and redness over calf. T 37.6. No skin break, no blister, no discharge from wound. HR 96, SpO2 97%. L calf tender, pitting edema till mid thigh.

54M, alcohol-related liver disease, still drinking, brought by wife with confusion and day-night sleep reversal x 2 days. Constipated x 4 days. No fever, no haematemesis, no black stools. BP 110/70, HR 88, T 37.0. Icterus +, mild ascites, flapping tremor +. Disoriented to time, no focal deficit, neck supple. RBS 118, Na 132.

62F, CLD (HBV related), on furosemide + spironolactone, c/o drowsiness, irrelevant talk x 1 d. Afebrile. BP 100/60, PR 84. Icteric, ascites +, asterixis +. Na 126, K 3.0, creat 1.3, RBS 110. No FND. Ascitic fluid PMN 40.

48M, known cirrhosis, black stools x 2 days and 1 episode of coffee-ground vomitus, now sleepy and slow to respond. BP 96/60, HR 108, afebrile. Pale, icteric, mild ascites; flap difficult to elicit due to drowsiness. Hb 7.8, platelets 70,000, INR 1.9, RBS 104, Na 134. Ascitic tap: PMN 80.

29F with palpitations, heat intolerance, loose stools and weight loss of 5 kg in 2 months despite a good appetite. Irritable. HR 118 regular, BP 132/60, T 37.4. Fine tremor, warm moist skin, diffuse neck swelling moving with swallowing, mild proptosis.
35F, c/o palpitation x 1 month, tremors, sweating ++, anxiety, scanty menses. Wt down 4 kg. No fever, no neck pain. PR 112, BP 128/70. Tremors +, thyroid diffusely enlarged with bruit.

70M, weight loss of 8 kg in 4 months, fatigue, breathlessness on exertion, irregular heartbeat. No tremor, no goitre palpable. No cough, no fever, appetite normal. HR 124 irregularly irregular, BP 140/70. Proximal muscle weakness. ECG: AF with fast ventricular rate. Hb 12.4, RBS 110.

27F with recurrent lower abdominal cramps for a year, relieved after passing stool, alternating loose and hard stools, and bloating; worse during exam stress. No blood in stool, no weight loss, no nocturnal diarrhoea, no fever. Abdomen soft, mild LIF tenderness. Hb 12.8, stool routine normal, TSH normal.

32M, IT job, c/o loose stools 3-4 times in the morning x 8 months, urgency after breakfast, abd discomfort relieved by defecation. No blood, no wt loss, no night symptoms. Appetite good. P/A soft NT. CBC, ESR, TSH normal; stool occult blood neg; tTG negative.

48F
Bloating and constipation with hard pellet stools x 3 yrs
Lower abdominal pain eases after passing stool
Anxious
No blood PR, no weight loss, no family h/o colon cancer
Colonoscopy 6 months back normal
P/A soft, mildly distended, NT
Hb 12.2, TSH 2.1

22F with red spots over legs for 5 days and gum bleeding while brushing. Heavy period last cycle. No fever, no joint pain, no new drugs. Afebrile, vitals stable. Petechiae and bruises on legs, blood blisters in the mouth. No hepatosplenomegaly, no lymph nodes. Hb 11.8, TLC 7,200, platelets 8,000. Smear: large platelets, no blasts, no schistocytes.

40M, c/o easy bruising x 2 wks, epistaxis x 2 episodes. No fever. No new meds. O/E: scattered ecchymoses, petechiae on shins. No splenomegaly, no LAP. Hb 14, TLC 8,000, Plt 18,000. PT/aPTT normal. HIV, HCV neg.

68F, HTN, on aspirin 75 mg, c/o red urine and purple patches on arms x 1 wk. No fever, no weight loss, no bone pain. BP 140/84. Ecchymoses on forearms, petechiae on legs. No splenomegaly, no nodes. Hb 12, TLC 6,800 with normal differential, platelets 12,000, smear no schistocytes, LDH normal, creat 0.9.

26F with recurrent throbbing one-sided headaches since her teens, 2 to 3 per month, each lasting about 12 hours, with nausea, photophobia and phonophobia, preceded by zigzag lines in vision for 20 minutes. Today a similar attack for 6 hours. Mother has similar headaches. Neuro exam and fundus normal, BP 118/76, afebrile.
31F, c/o headache L side x 1 day, pulsating, vomiting x 2, wants a dark room. Similar episodes around menses x 5 yrs. No fever, no neck stiffness, no weakness. BP 120/80. CNS NAD, fundus normal.

38M
Tingling spreading from R hand up the arm to the face over 20 min
Then throbbing headache with vomiting
Similar episode 1 yr back
No weakness, no speech problem
BP 126/80, afebrile
CNS exam normal now, no neck stiffness
RBS 102

24M with puffiness of the face on waking and swelling of both legs for 3 weeks, with frothy urine. No dark urine, urine volume normal. BP 124/80. Periorbital puffiness, pitting pedal edema, mild ascites. Urine albumin 4+, no RBCs. Serum albumin 1.9, cholesterol 380, creatinine 0.8.

55F, k/c/o DM x 15 yrs, c/o B/L pedal edema x 2 months, frothy urine. No SOB, no orthopnea. BP 150/90. Pedal edema ++, facial puffiness. Urine prot 3+. S. albumin 2.4, 24 h urine protein 5.2 g, creat 1.2. Fundus: diabetic retinopathy.

B/L basal dullness

34F, on oral contraceptive pills, returned from an 18 hour bus journey 3 days ago. Sudden breathlessness and right pleuritic chest pain today. No fever, no cough. HR 118, RR 28, BP 118/76, SpO2 90% RA, T 37.2. Chest clear. Right calf swollen and tender. ECG: sinus tachycardia, S1Q3T3. CXR normal.

58M, POD 6 after hip fracture fixation, sudden SOB this AM, anxious, sweating. PR 124, BP 104/68, RR 30, SpO2 88% on RA. Chest clear, no wheeze. L calf swollen. ECG: sinus tachy, new RBBB. D-dimer high.

40F, c/o sudden L sided chest pain on breathing and one episode of blood-streaked sputum today, breathless. H/o 2 miscarriages. No fever. HR 108, RR 24, SpO2 93%, BP 120/78. Chest: few crackles L base. CXR: small L effusion, peripheral wedge-shaped opacity.

65F, bedbound after a stroke 3 weeks ago, sudden collapse and breathlessness. BP 80/50, HR 130, RR 32, SpO2 82% RA. JVP raised, chest clear. Cold peripheries. ECG: sinus tachycardia, T inversion V1-V4. Troponin mildly raised.

72M, k/c/o Ca prostate, c/o breathlessness x 3 days, worse today, mild dry cough, low grade temp 37.8. No sputum. HR 112, RR 26, BP 124/74, SpO2 91%. Chest: few crepts R base. CXR: R basal atelectasis, small effusion. TLC 10,400, CRP 24. L leg swollen.

Breathless x 2 days

L leg swelling 2 wks back, treated as muscle sprain
No chest pain, no fever, no cough
PR 116, BP 100/70, RR 26, SpO2 92% RA
Chest clear

68F with pain and stiffness of both shoulders and hips for 6 weeks, morning stiffness lasting 2 hours, difficulty combing hair and getting out of bed. Low grade fever, fatigue, weight loss of 3 kg. No headache, no jaw pain on chewing, no visual symptoms. Proximal muscles tender but power normal. Small joints normal. ESR 78, CRP 46, CPK normal, RA factor negative.
72M, c/o B/L shoulder girdle and thigh pain with stiffness x 2 months, worse in AM, can't get up from chair without help. Power normal on testing. No headache. ESR 92, Hb 10.8, CPK 60, TSH normal.

Mild B/L wrist swelling

44F with sudden severe headache while lifting a bucket, the worst of her life, peaking within a minute, followed by vomiting and brief loss of consciousness. Now drowsy, GCS 14. BP 180/100, HR 64, afebrile. Neck stiffness present, no focal deficit, pupils equal and reactive.
52M, k/c/o HTN, c/o sudden severe occipital headache during sex x 6 h. Vomiting ++, photophobia. No fever. BP 190/110, PR 58. GCS 15. Neck rigidity +, no FND.
74F, HTN, sudden headache 6 h ago while at prayer, then collapsed. Now confused, vomiting. Neck supple. BP 200/110, HR 88. GCS 13, R ptosis with dilated R pupil. No fever. RBS 130.

30M started on carbamazepine 2 weeks ago for seizures, now fever for 3 days with a painful red rash spreading over trunk and face with blisters, mouth ulcers, burning red eyes and painful micturition. T 38.6, HR 110. Dusky target-like macules with blisters, Nikolsky sign positive, detachment about 8% BSA. Oral and genital erosions, conjunctival congestion.

45F, c/o fever, sore throat then rash with blisters x 2 d. Took cotrimoxazole for UTI 10 d back. T 38.4, PR 106, BP 110/70. Lips crusted, oral erosions, B/L conjunctivitis. Dusky macules on trunk with flaccid bullae, skin peeling ~30% BSA, Nikolsky +.

CKD 3, started allopurinol 300 mg 3 wks ago for raised uric acid
Itchy rash, now painful and blistering x 3 days

T 38.2, HR 104, BP 100/60

Oral and lip erosions
